VR.title: Immersed Says It’s Finally Getting Ready to Ship ‘Visor’ VR Headset
VR.summary: Immersed is set to ship its long-awaited Visor VR headset, focusing on work applications, following an update to pre-order customers.

VR.title: Quest's Horizon+ Subscription Added 10 Monthly Hours Of Xbox Games
VR.summary: Meta's Horizon+ subscription now includes 10 hours of Xbox cloud gaming monthly, enhancing its value for Quest users.

VR.title: Mixed Reality Tower Defense Game Cybercore Protocol Out Now In Early Access On Quest
VR.summary: Cybercore Protocol, a mixed reality tower defense game, has launched in Early Access on Quest, offering new gameplay experiences.

VR.title: Roboquest VR Launches Today On Quest 3 Along With Cross-Platform Co-Op
VR.summary: Roboquest VR has launched on Meta Quest 3, featuring cross-platform co-op play, expanding its multiplayer capabilities.

VR.title: Meta Horizon+ now includes Xbox Game Pass at no extra cost
VR.summary: Meta Horizon+ subscribers can now access over 50 Xbox Game Pass titles at no additional cost, enhancing the subscription's appeal.

VR.title: A.R. Rahman Brings His Immersive Music Experiences To Apple Vision Pro
VR.summary: A.R. Rahman launched ARR Immersive for Apple Vision Pro, offering a unique blend of music and performance in immersive formats.

AI.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
AI.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Opus 5, a new AI model that approaches the capabilities of its predecessor, Claude Fable 5.

AI.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
AI.summary: Nvidia and Microsoft have formed the Open Secure AI Alliance to develop open-source AI security tools, excluding major players like OpenAI.

AI.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
AI.summary: Perplexity has launched its Personal Computer tool for Windows, allowing PCs to function as locally run AI agents.

AI.title: AI leaders sign a statement asking the government to do something about automated AI
AI.summary: Leaders from top AI firms have urged the US government to implement coordinated governance to manage the rapid development of AI technologies.

AI.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
AI.summary: Microsoft has unveiled new AI security tools that it claims outperform competitors while being more cost-effective.

AI.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
AI.summary: China's Moonshot AI has introduced a competitive AI model, raising concerns in Silicon Valley about its capabilities and cost efficiency.

NFL.title: Denzel Ward agrees to two-year contract extension with Browns
NFL.summary: Denzel Ward has signed a two-year contract extension with the Browns worth $62.2 million, including $52.3 million guaranteed.

NFL.title: Commanders sign P Matt Haack with Tress Way sidelined by pec injury
NFL.summary: The Commanders have signed punter Matt Haack to fill in as Tress Way recovers from a pec injury.

NFL.title: 49ers to sign DE KJ Henry
NFL.summary: The 49ers are set to sign defensive end KJ Henry, bolstering their defensive line ahead of the season.

NFL.title: Mason Rudolph to begin camp as Steelers' No. 2 QB
NFL.summary: Mason Rudolph will begin training camp as the Steelers' No. 2 quarterback, as the team prepares for the upcoming season.

NFL.title: Commanders offensive assistant Wes Welker will work with the team's tight ends
NFL.summary: Wes Welker has been appointed to work with the Commanders' tight ends after the team opted for an internal replacement.

NFL.title: Tank Dell avoids PUP list to open Texans camp
NFL.summary: Wide receiver Tank Dell has avoided the PUP list to open Texans camp, signaling his readiness for the upcoming season.
